title: Tower comparison intertwines affine exchange at the Tate unit
statement: Let N>0, let A be a finite commutative ring with NA=0 and let t be normalized finite Tate transport. Let f:T→S be a morphism of Noetherian schemes, with N invertible on S, and d≥0. Use the ordered affine left and right functors, exchange and right base-change maps of [def-amb-affine-trace-construction], and the specified ordinary-compact-support comparison κ of [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. Put K_S=R_S(1_S), K_T=R_T(1_T), and b:f_d* K_S≅K_T equal to affineTraceRightBaseChange at 1_S followed by R_T of the constant-unit pullback. Then f*(κ_S.inv), followed by affineTraceExchange(f,d,K_S) and L_T(b.hom), equals ordinary compact-support exchange for the Cartesian tower square at K_S, followed by R p_T!(b.hom) and κ_T.inv. No vector bundle, trivialization, inverse-chart square or integration counit is asserted.

source.place: Overlap calculation: transport of the ordered tower exchange through the bounded-below/unbounded compact-support comparisons.

proof.text: Use the constructed unbounded tower comparison and its bounded-below restriction identity. Affine-space top trace places each canonical Tate coefficient in D+, so the restriction identity identifies the specified endpoint comparison with the constructed unbounded comparison at that coefficient.

Prove exchange compatibility of the constructed comparison for every unbounded coefficient by induction on the tower. For zero, derive identity exchange from the compact-support composition base-change equation for the identity pair, unit compatibility, cancellation of invertible exchange, and faithfulness of identity compact supports. For a successor, transport the ordinary exact-pullback composition equation through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. Compactification independence and transitivity identify line exchange with ordinary line exchange under the line comparison. Apply the induction hypothesis and naturality to paste the successor square.

Identify both endpoint comparisons at the canonical Tate coefficients using the restriction calculation. Apply naturality of the target tower comparison to the canonical coefficient isomorphism b, use the unbounded tower exchange equation, and cancel the comparison isomorphisms. This gives precisely the displayed equation for all dimensions, including zero, empty bases and the zero ring.

proof_origin.place: Overlap calculation; B3 proves the unbounded exchange induction and endpoint naturality, isolating only the comparison restriction identity.

theorem affineTraceUnitCompactComparison_baseChange
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {T S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian T] [IsNoetherian S]
    (f : T ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    let b := affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t f hS d (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≪≫
      (affineTraceRight A N hA T d).mapIso (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f)
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
        (affineLinearCompactComparison N hN A hA S hS d).inv ≫
      affineTraceExchange A f d
        ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
      (affineTraceLeft A T d).map b.hom =
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A (affineTraceMap_isPullback f d)).app
        ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (affineTraceProjection T d)).map b.hom ≫
      (affineLinearCompactComparison N hN A hA T
        (affineTracePullbackInvertible N f hS) d).inv
